0022600127.text: The Denver Nuggets (1-1, 8th in the West and 1 game back in the Northwest) host the 0-3 Golden State Warriors (15th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Pacific), with Denver riding a one-game winning streak while Golden State has lost three straight. Denver will be without Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Golden State is missing Al Horford, Brandin Podziemski, Draymond Green, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody, and Stephen Curry (rest), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with an undisclosed reason and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though they split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Denver won the most recent meeting 116-93 in Denver on March 29, 2026.
